name: Presence
description: Publishes tracked devices' online/offline state to Home Assistant (webhook), MQTT, or any HTTP endpoint, so the house can react to a phone joining or leaving. Opt-in per MAC — nothing is published for a device you haven't chosen to track.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pr_tracked (mac VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(100), subnet_id INT NULL, added_by VARCHAR(100), added_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pr_state (mac VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, online TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, since DATETIME NULL, last_seen DATETIME NULL, misses INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pr_sinks (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, kind ENUM('ha_webhook','mqtt','http') NOT NULL, url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, credential TEXT, topic_prefix VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jen/presence', retain TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, discovery TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_error VARCHAR(300) NULL)
